pages.text: A cake sat on the table. It had five candles.
Mom lit the candles. The room lights went out, and only the cake shone brightly.
"I'm going to blow them all out at once." Pongi took a big breath.
Dad leaned down beside her. "I'll help too."
Whooo! They both blew at the same time.
All the candles went out. The cake gave a little wobble.
A puff of cream flew up. Pongi's eyes opened wide.
The cream landed right on Dad's nose. Dad could only blink and blink.
Pongi's little brother dipped a finger in the cream. Then he ate it.
Everyone laughed. A little cream was still left on Dad's nose.
